ruchaka_yoga.citation: Three Hundred Important Combinations, Yoga No. 22, Chart No. 23 (p. 17); Notable Horoscopes, Ch. 58 (p. 312)
ruchaka_yoga.notes: Ruchaka Yoga is explicitly documented by Dr. Raman as formed by Mars occupying its own sign Aries in the 7th Kendra from Libra Lagna.

manglik_dosha.notes: Kuja Dosha in 7th house explicitly analyzed by Dr. Raman as a severe affliction. Jupiter's aspect from Sagittarius is ineligible for cancellation because Libra Lagna makes Jupiter lord of 3rd and 6th (functional malefic). Dosha confirmed.

budhaditya_yoga.notes: Sun and Mercury both occupy Aries in the 7th house; Budhaditya Yoga is independently derived from published coordinates.
